extras: Requires an internet connection for lookups. Merriam-Webster requires a free API key for non-commercial use.
intentEvidence: Build a dictionary in your vault: look up definitions, idioms, and quotes, and save each one as a note using your own templates.
problem: Users need a structured way to capture and organize definitions, idioms, and quotes directly within their Obsidian vault without leaving the application.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Book Search by anpigon (MIT License). Dictionary Notes follows its workflow but doesn't include its code.

summary: Dictionary Notes allows users to build a personal dictionary within their vault by looking up definitions, idioms, and quotes from various online sources and saving them as templated notes.
